label: rem:mass-energy-electron-check
title: Electron consistency check for $E = \mathfrak{m} c_q^2$
html:
The mass--energy relation E = \mathfrak{m} \cdot c_q^2 (mass--energy equivalence) admits a concrete consistency check using the electron.

Consistency check: electron. The electron (left trefoil T_{2,3}) has n_c = 3 positive crossings:

  • Crossing energy: E_{e^-} = 3q \approx 3.330 Skein units.
  • Predicted mass: \mathfrak{m}_{e^-} = E \cdot (q-1)^2 = 3q(q-1)^2.

At q = q_0, \mathfrak{m}_{e^-} = 3 q_0 \times 0.01203 \approx 0.0401 in Reeb mass units.
